participant_method_evidence.method_summary: Frozen TAP-CT and SPECTRE representations are combined through distillation and feature aggregation, followed by a linear classifier. SPECTRE contributes vision-language-aligned representations.
participant_method_evidence.result_scope: Participant reports first place and provides a final-test results table; retained as participant-reported evidence, not a replacement for organizer ranking rules.
participant_method_evidence.vision_language_interpretation: Supports use of vision-language-aligned representations in a participant method. Does not independently establish execution or results of the separate vision-language embedding-aggregation track, or an explicit image-language evaluation endpoint.

participant_method_evidence.title: Disease-Adaptive Multi-Representation Fusion for General CT Diagnosis
participant_method_evidence.method: DAMF combines global and spatial representations from a frozen CT-NEXUS vision-only encoder with disease-specific classification/fusion heads.
participant_method_evidence.limitations: Table 1 explicitly distinguishes local development results from challenge rankings. Validation selected checkpoints and fusion weights; the closing paragraph explicitly does not infer an official test rank. No evidence for the separate vision-language track is supplied.

participant_method_evidence.pretraining: Paired CT volumes, radiology reports and structured clinical supervision, as described in section 3.2.
participant_method_evidence.evaluated_pipeline: CT volume -> frozen volumetric representation -> target-specific classifier and decision threshold.
participant_method_evidence.language_use_scope: Vision-language pretraining provenance; no explicit text input, text output or image-language endpoint described in the reported downstream evaluation.
participant_method_evidence.track_identity: Not explicitly stated in this PDF. Association with the CVPR 2026 submission is supplied by the user-pasted OpenReview venue context; a specific VLM track is not independently established.
participant_method_evidence.validation_instance_scope: 1898 target-wise validation instances; not asserted to be 1898 unique patients or scans.
participant_method_evidence.interpretation: Confirms adaptation of a vision-language-pretrained representation for image classification at the participant-method level; does not establish completed assessment of an image-language capability or a specific final VLM-track result.
